package.name: gesture_teleop
package.description: Human-arm gesture teleoperation for the OpenArm bimanual robot: MediaPipe Pose retargeted onto the 7-DoF arms via a closed-form S-R-S solver, with an explicit-arm dead-man-switch safety pipeline, plus a separate non-actuating browser mockup (own webcam, bone-line overlay, drawn arm) served on its own port. See src/perception/gesture_teleop/README.md.
